common.name: Name (optional)
common.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Avoid common passwords.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.phoneHint: We send a code by WhatsApp (or SMS). No password needed.
signIn.codeSent: We sent a code to {phone}. It expires in 5 minutes.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in 60 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

errors.breached: This password is too common or has appeared in data breaches.
errors.contains_identity: The password must not contain your name or email.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid mobile number, for example 059-123-4567.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one.
errors.account_disabled: This account is not active. Please contact us.
errors.delivery_failed: We could not send the code right now. Try again shortly.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid, already used or expired. Request a new one.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.not_enrolled: Two-step verification is not set up yet.
errors.already_enrolled: Two-step verification is already set up for this account.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.not_staff: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.self_action: You cannot do this to your own account.
errors.last_owner: There must always be at least one active owner.
errors.invalid_state: This action is not possible in the user's current state.

signIn.title: Back-office sign in
signIn.intro: Staff only. After your password you will need a code from your authenticator app.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

setup.title: Set up two-step verification
setup.intro: Two-step verification is required for the back office. Add this account to an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
setup.recoveryIntro: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe now — they will not be shown again.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.mustChange: You must choose a new password before continuing.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: Your account does not have permission to open this page.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Back-office accounts. Suspending or revoking a user signs them out at once.

confirm.suspend: Suspend {name}? They will be signed out now and cannot sign in until reinstated.
confirm.revoke: Revoke {name} permanently? This cannot be undone. Their history is kept.
confirm.resetTwoFactor: Reset two-step verification for {name}? They will be signed out and must set it up again.

create.title: Add a user
create.name: Full name
create.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a temporary password. The user must change it after signing in.
create.tempPassword: Temporary password — shown only once. Give it to the user privately:
